what_this_is: Every execution-capable thing a project repository can name, as one document. The project service's tests build a real repository from this, plant each entry as a program that writes a sentinel file when it runs, and then run a status, a review refresh, a clone and an adoption against it. No sentinel may appear. This is the fixture behind KR-ACC-030, KR-REQ-14.23 and KR-REQ-14.24: argument-vector construction alone is not the isolation, so the isolation is tested by trying to trigger each helper.

marker_program.how_it_is_planted: The script is copied into the fixture repository with @SENTINELS@ replaced by an absolute directory on the internal disk. It takes one argument, the name of the entry that invoked it, and appends that name to a file of the same name inside that directory. It exits zero, so a helper that runs does not also fail the command and hide itself.

refused.why: it names the remote helper program git-remote-planted, and a remote helper is not something a command-line override removes: the operation is refused instead
URL rewriting is multi-valued, so an override adds to the list rather than replacing it; an operation that would resolve a URL through it is refused instead
